item.description:
NVBeacon is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH with `nvidia-smi`, process exit alerts, and GPU idle notifications.
- Added an opt-in GPU History window with up to 24 hours of per-user GPU utilization. Turn on **Record GPU history** in Settings, then open the chart from the menu bar popover to view activity by server and GPU. - Fixed GPU and host metrics collection on servers that use fish as their login shell. - Thanks @Moviw for contributing GPU history and the fish compatibility fix in [#5](https://github.com/jaein4722/NVBeacon/pull/5) and [#11](https://github.com/jaein4722/NVBeacon/pull/11).
